targets.query:
from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_base_value" or r._field == "local_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

targets.query:

fieldName = fieldSel
scalarFields = ["explained_value", "explanation_output", "explanation_error_code", "explained_model", "explainability_mode", "explanation_method", "explanation_profile", "explanation_status", "explainability_seed", "feature_fingerprint", "hstree_anomaly", "hstree_model_fingerprint", "hstree_model_version", "hstree_score", "hstree_status", "hstree_threshold", "local_hstree_score", "kitnet_anomaly", "kitnet_score", "kitnet_status", "kitnet_threshold", "local_score", "reference_anomaly", "reference_model", "reference_score", "reference_status", "reference_threshold", "model_version", "model_fingerprint", "shap_background_size", "shap_base_value", "shap_computation_time_ms", "shap_nsamples"]

from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if fieldSel == "ALL" then not contains(value: r._field, set: scalarFields) else r._field == fieldName)
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "last")

panels.title: KitNET SHAP contribution of a feature

targets.query:
fieldSel = if "${feature}" == "" then "ALL" else "${feature}"
groupSel = if "${group}" == "" then "ALL" else "${group}"

ban = ["timestamp","LabviewTime","LabViewTime","StepNumber","Cycle"]

from(bucket: "source-data")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "source-data")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not contains(value: r._field, set: ban))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => fieldSel == "ALL" or r._field == fieldSel)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => groupSel == "ALL" or r.Group == groupSel)
  |> drop(columns: ["host", "_measurement"])

from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "explanation_status")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with status: r._value}))
  |> group(columns: ["status", "Group"])
  |> count()
  |> group(columns: ["status"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["status"], columnKey: ["Group"], valueColumn: "_value")
  // Collapse the status group key so Grafana receives status as the x field.
  |> group()
  // Keep one row per status and one numeric column per selected group.
  // Grafana renders each group column as a separate coloured series.
  |> sort(columns: ["status"], desc: true)
  |> yield(name: "results_by_status_and_group")

panels.title: How many Explainability V1 KitNET results were produced per selected group?
panels.description: Each bar category is an explanation status, such as warmup or computed. Each colour represents one selected group, so the height of a coloured segment shows how many results that group produced in the selected time range. The warmup count can decrease in a rolling time range because older warmup results leave the window.

targets.query:
import "math"

upstream_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "reference_score")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")

local_stream =
  from(bucket: "explainability")
    |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "local_score")
    |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")

union(tables: [upstream_stream, local_stream])
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "Group", "source_event_id"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.reference_score and exists r.local_score)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      identical_scores: if math.abs(x: r.reference_score - r.local_score) <= 0.000001 then 1 else 0,
      different_scores: if math.abs(x: r.reference_score - r.local_score) > 0.000001 then 1 else 0,
      compared_scores: 1,
    }))
  |> group(columns: ["Group"])
  |> reduce(
      fn: (r, accumulator = {compared_scores: 0, identical_scores: 0, different_scores: 0}) => ({
        compared_scores: accumulator.compared_scores + r.compared_scores,
        identical_scores: accumulator.identical_scores + r.identical_scores,
        different_scores: accumulator.different_scores + r.different_scores,
      }),
      identity: {compared_scores: 0, identical_scores: 0, different_scores: 0},
    )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      identical_rate: float(v: r.identical_scores) / float(v: r.compared_scores),
    }))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["Group", "compared_scores", "identical_scores", "different_scores", "identical_rate"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Group"])
  |> yield(name: "kitnet_score_fidelity_by_group")

panels.title: KitNET score fidelity by group
panels.description: For each selected group, this table counts the scores that are identical or different between upstream KitNET and local Explainability. Scores are compared event by event; identical means an absolute difference of at most 0.000001. Warmup events are excluded because one or both scores may be unavailable.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_computation_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1s, fn: last, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_time")
  |> drop(columns: ["source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "shap_time")

from(bucket: "explainability")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "explainability")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.explained_model == "kitnet")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "shap_computation_time_ms")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => if "${group}" == "" or "${group}" == "ALL" then true else r.Group == "${group}")
  |> group(columns: ["Group"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time", "source_event_id"])
  |> movingAverage(n: 100)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _field: "shap_computation_time_ms_ma100"}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field", "Group"])
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "source_event_id", "host", "_measurement"])
  |> yield(name: "shap_time_ma100")
